_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Los Angeles City College's front matter: what the catalog prints for an associate degree's general education (the LACCD GE Plan and Cal-GETC, and the units of each) and its 60 units, and what an Associate Degree for Transfer requires. 24 local degrees print 'Major Units: N' and 'Total Units: Minimum of 60' and no GE pattern, and read unequal against the 60; 16 transfer degrees read incomplete. Its words become the college's reconcile steps. Pages 1-72 only, before the program pages (Business Administration's State Code heading is pdf page 76). One load, no model call.

questions.ge_units: The units of the LACCD GE Plan and Cal-GETC, the catalog's words for an associate degree's 60 units, and whether electives make up the 60.
questions.adt: What the catalog prints for an Associate Degree for Transfer: its 60 units, Cal-GETC, and the units in the major.
